title: Clarify literature skill routing boundary
description: Updates AGENTS so literature-search owns retrieval and screening, while literature-research owns field mapping, gap discovery, research-direction recommendation, and idea ranking.
changes: Add literature-research to the visible skill list with a distinct synthesis role.
Change Stage 3-6 from always loading literature-search to selecting literature-search or literature-research by user intent.
Keep retrieval query/tool details delegated to skill and tool schema versions.
Require literature-research outputs before summarizing research gaps or idea rankings.

rollback.notes: Restore the previous AGENTS snapshot if the routing split causes unexpected skill selection.
